definitions.gloss: fever caused by illness; fever from disease
definitions.explanation: An elevated body temperature resulting from illness or disease. Distinguished from fever caused by external factors like heat exhaustion.

examples.japanese: {病熱|びょうねつ}で{寝込|ねこ}んでいる。
examples.english: She is bedridden with fever from illness.

examples.japanese: {病熱|びょうねつ}が{下|さ}がらず、{入院|にゅういん}することになった。
examples.english: The fever from the illness wouldn't go down, so hospitalization was decided.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{病熱|びょうねつ}に{苦|くる}しみながらも、{最後|さいご}まで{原稿|げんこう}を{書|か}き{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: Despite suffering from fever, he continued writing his manuscript to the very end.

notes:
Composed of {病|びょう} (illness, disease) and {熱|ねつ} (heat, fever). A literary word more commonly found in novels and historical writing than in everyday conversation.

In everyday speech, simply {熱|ねつ} (fever) or {熱|ねつ}がある (to have a fever) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {病熱|びょうねつ}に{苦|くる}しむ (to suffer from fever)
- {病熱|びょうねつ}で{倒|たお}れる (to collapse from fever)
- {病熱|びょうねつ}が{続|つづ}く (fever persists)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {病熱|びょうねつ}: fever caused by illness (literary)
- {発熱|はつねつ}: developing a fever (medical, clinical)
- {高熱|こうねつ}: high fever (describes severity)
